2609.09735.title: Can Artificial Intelligence Support Healthcare and Mental Health Through Early Cyberbullying Detection ? The Impact of Emotion-Aware AI on Proactive Online Safety
2609.09735.paper_summary: Healthcare systems, mental health, and public well-being are increasingly affected by cyberbullying and harmful online interactions. This paper presents CareGuard, an early-warning framework designed to support healthcare-driven mental health protection and proactive online safety through the detection of cyberbullying-related content using advanced natural language processing techniques. CareGuard integrates zero-shot semantic labeling with fine-tuned transformer-based models, including BERT, DistilBERT, and RoBERTa, to enable robust and context-aware classification across sensitive cyberbullying categories. To improve efficiency and reduce unnecessary computation in healthcare-oriented monitoring settings, the framework incorporates an emotion-aware filtering mechanism alongside cosine similarity-based semantic screening, allowing the system to focus on semantically relevant and emotionally salient content. Experimental results on benchmark datasets demonstrate that CareGuard effectively balances detection accuracy and computational efficiency, highlighting its potential for scalable deployment in healthcare systems, mental health monitoring, and online safety applications.
2609.09735.paper_summary_zh: 醫療系統、心理健康和公共福祉日益受到網路霸凌和有害的線上互動影響。本文提出了 CareGuard，一個早期預警框架，旨在通過使用先進的自然語言處理技術檢測與網路霸凌相關的內容，支持以醫療為驅動的心理健康保護和主動的線上安全。CareGuard 將零樣本語義標記與微調的基於Transformer的模型（包括 BERT、DistilBERT 和 RoBERTa）整合在一起，以實現對敏感網路霸凌類別的穩健和上下文感知的分類。為了提高效率並減少醫療導向監控環境中的不必要計算，該框架結合了情感感知過濾機制和基於餘弦相似度的語義篩選，允許系統專注於語義相關和情感突出的內容。在基準數據集上的實驗結果表明，CareGuard 有效平衡了檢測準確性和計算效率，突顯了其在醫療系統、心理健康監測和線上安全應用中的可擴展部署潛力。
